definitions.gloss: emergency meeting; extraordinary meeting; ad hoc meeting
definitions.explanation: A meeting convened outside the regular schedule to address an urgent or unexpected matter that requires immediate discussion.

examples.japanese: {臨時会議|りんじかいぎ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{招集|しょうしゅう}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}した→発生する：25529_hasseisuru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{急遽|きゅうきょ}→急遽：12575_kyuukyo⟧{臨時会議|りんじかいぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧ことになった。
examples.english: A problem arose, so it was decided to hold an emergency meeting on short notice.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{全部門|ぜんぶもん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{責任者|せきにんしゃ}→責任者：17175_sekininsha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}めて→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧{臨時会議|りんじかいぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}い→行う：01238_okonau⟧、⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{協議|きょうぎ}→協議：02635_kyougi⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The president gathered all department heads for an emergency meeting to discuss countermeasures.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{臨時|りんじ}→臨時：04092_rinji⟧ (extraordinary, ad hoc) + ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧ (meeting, conference). Conveys urgency — used when a situation demands immediate collective discussion outside the normal meeting schedule.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {臨時会議|りんじかいぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧: to hold an emergency meeting
- {臨時会議|りんじかいぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{招集|しょうしゅう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to convene an emergency meeting
- {臨時会議|りんじかいぎ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われる→行う：01238_okonau⟧: an emergency meeting is held
- ⟦{緊急|きんきゅう}→緊急：11327_kinkyuu⟧{臨時会議|りんじかいぎ}: urgent emergency meeting

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{定期会議|ていきかいぎ}→定期会議：27197_teikikaigi⟧: regular meeting (scheduled at fixed intervals)
- {緊急会議|きんきゅうかいぎ}: emergency meeting (even more urgent in tone)
- {臨時総会|りんじそうかい}: extraordinary general meeting (formal corporate/organizational term)
